research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official occupation/qualification extract, inaugural and later first-person speeches, December 2024 government transcript, public professional-profile index, employer/government school records, ABR charity history, party/personal biographies and contemporary election reporting.

Teaching 2011–2025 is a career envelope spanning multiple schools and at least public and nonprofit sectors; not a single continuous public employment spell. Approximately ten NT years and return four years before December 2024 are not precise boundaries. No 14-year headline calculated.

Indexed LinkedIn profile matched by location and employers; visible role dates/hours absent. Direct open returned 999 Unknown Status Code. No bypass attempted. Namesakes in Montana, Colorado, UK and Sydney swimming were excluded; unrelated profile snippets are not career evidence.

Annual-report searches for Ramingining and Anula did not establish dates or hours. Indie 2023 report https://awcc.edu.au/site/assets/files/2549/ie_2023_annual_report_website.pdf returned 404; current report page exposed heading but no report links in accessible text. Government 2022–23 report indexed approval of Launceston campus, but opening date is not employee start date.

Unpaid campaign leave is a material break requiring exact boundaries. Departmental and school titles do not prove substantive full-time employment. Study, volunteering and elected office are excluded. Public and private totals remain null; absence of private evidence is not zero.

Next leads: historical Ramingining/Anula staff newsletters and annual reports, legitimate complete public professional dates, Riverside/Prospect appointment and transfer records, Indie 2023–25 staff lists and leave/resignation evidence; clarify other NT postings, any pre-2011 paid jobs and study/work overlaps.
